summary: The table presents the quarterly financial performance across various sectors for the periods ending December 31, 2025, September 30, 2025, and December 31, 2024. It includes sectors such as Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others. The table also shows year-over-year growth both reported and in constant currency (CC). Notably, Manufacturing shows the highest reported YoY growth at 10.8%, while the total YoY growth is 3.2% reported and 1.7% in CC. The data highlights sectoral performance and growth trends over the specified periods.
